# The obee process dies while the run waits for an answer about red tests. The next obee run continues the same run: the update and the three gate
# runs do not repeat, and the question is the same. The answer retry runs the gate again, the gate passes, and the pull request opens once.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
maintinit
maintfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env GIT_BASE=file://$WORK/remotes
env UPKEEP_WEEK=2026-W44
# A failed script leaves its run in the wait for an answer. The short deadline ends that run, so no process outlives the script.
env RED_TIMEOUT=90s

exec obeereal item add api bump-api-2026-W44 --title 'Bump dependencies in api (2026-W44)' --body-file body.json
! exec obeereal run bump-api-2026-W44 api --workflow home/.upkeep/bump.star &
waitstatus 'The tests of api fail after the bump'
grep -count=2 '^fix$' calls.log
kill -KILL
wait

exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-bump-api-2026-W44-r1\trunning\tpaused: .*The tests of api fail'

exec obeereal run bump-api-2026-W44 api --workflow home/.upkeep/bump.star &
waitstatus 'The tests of api fail after the bump'
exec obeereal answer bump-api-2026-W44 retry
wait
stdout 'item bump-api-2026-W44 finished'

# Across both processes: one update, two fix rounds (both before the question), four gate runs (the fourth passes), one pull request.
grep -count=1 '^update$' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^fix$' calls.log
grep -count=4 '^go test' tools.log
grep -count=1 'gh pr create --draft --head upkeep/api-2026-W44' gh.log
grep '^2026-W44\tapi\topened\thttps://github.example/acme/pull/1\tdraft pull request\t' home/.upkeep/runs.tsv
grep '^last_pr=https://github.example/acme/pull/1$' home/.upkeep/state/api.env
exec git -C remotes/acme/api show --stat upkeep/api-2026-W44
stdout 'go.sum'
exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-bump-api-2026-W44-r1\tdone'

-- body.json --
{"repo":"api","week":"2026-W44","base":"main","fingerprint":"fp-1","table":"go\texample.com/lib\tv1.2.0\tv1.3.0"}
-- gate-results --
red
red
red
green
-- fixtures/go-api.json --
{"Path":"acme/api","Main":true}
{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.2.0","Update":{"Path":"example.com/lib","Version":"v1.3.0"}}
